\section[(dialogue)]{Fruit, vegetables and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R129-first-pass-fruit-vegetables-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an eraser and a bag.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item slippers, a scarf, a necklace, a jackal, a bat
  \item an owl, a parrot, a pigeon, a sparrow, a heron
  \item a fly, a mosquito, an earthworm, a gecko, a turtle
  \item a cat, an elbow, the chest, the waist, an ankle
  \item a fingernail, a cheek, the forehead, an eyebrow, a bone
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Slippers? (\textbf{\bn{চটি}}, \emph{chôṭi}.) A scarf? (\textbf{\bn{মাফলার}}, \emph{māphlār}.) A necklace? (\textbf{\bn{হার}}, \emph{hār}.) A jackal? (\textbf{\bn{শিয়াল}}, \emph{shiyāl}.) A bat? (\textbf{\bn{বাদুড়}}, \emph{bādur}.) An owl? (\textbf{\bn{প্যাঁচা}}, \emph{pyā̃chā}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\bn{টিয়া}}, \emph{tiyā}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\bn{কবুতর}}, \emph{kôbutôr}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\bn{চড়ুই}}, \emph{chôṛui}.) A heron? (\textbf{\bn{বক}}, \emph{bôk}.) A fly? (\textbf{\bn{মাছি}}, \emph{māchhi}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\bn{মশা}}, \emph{môshā}.) An earthworm? (\textbf{\bn{কেঁচো}}, \emph{kechô}.) A gecko? (\textbf{\bn{টিকটিকি}}, \emph{ṭikṭiki}.) A turtle? (\textbf{\bn{কচ্ছপ}}, \emph{kôchchhôp}.) A cat? (\textbf{\bn{বেড়াল}}, \emph{beṛāl}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\bn{কনুই}}, \emph{kônui}.) The chest? (\textbf{\bn{বুক}}, \emph{buk}.) The waist? (\textbf{\bn{কোমর}}, \emph{kômôr}.) An ankle? (\textbf{\bn{গোড়ালি}}, \emph{goṛāli}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\bn{নখ}}, \emph{nôkh}.) A cheek? (\textbf{\bn{গাল}}, \emph{gāl}.) The forehead? (\textbf{\bn{কপাল}}, \emph{kopāl}.) An eyebrow? (\textbf{\bn{ভুরু}}, \emph{bhuru}.) A bone? (\textbf{\bn{হাড়}}, \emph{hāṛ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Clothes and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R129-second-pass-clothes-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for skin and a fisherman.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item skin, a fisherman, a blacksmith, a potter, a weaver
  \item a barber, a tailor, a washerman, a grocer, a nurse
  \item a king, a queen, a priest, a factory, a labourer
  \item a salary, a port, a ship, a train, a ticket
  \item a mosque, a church, a pencil, an eraser, a bag
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Skin? (\textbf{\bn{চামড়া}}, \emph{chāmṛā}.) A fisherman? (\textbf{\bn{জেলে}}, \emph{jele}.) A blacksmith? (\textbf{\bn{কামার}}, \emph{kāmār}.) A potter? (\textbf{\bn{কুমোর}}, \emph{kumor}.) A weaver? (\textbf{\bn{তাঁতি}}, \emph{tā̃ti}.) A barber? (\textbf{\bn{নাপিত}}, \emph{nāpit}.) A tailor? (\textbf{\bn{দর্জি}}, \emph{dôrji}.) A washerman? (\textbf{\bn{ধোপা}}, \emph{dhopā}.) A grocer? (\textbf{\bn{মুদি}}, \emph{mudi}.) A nurse? (\textbf{\bn{নার্স}}, \emph{nārs}.) A king? (\textbf{\bn{রাজা}}, \emph{rājā}.) A queen? (\textbf{\bn{রানি}}, \emph{rāni}.) A priest? (\textbf{\bn{পুজারি}}, \emph{pujāri}.) A factory? (\textbf{\bn{কারখানা}}, \emph{kārkhānā}.) A labourer? (\textbf{\bn{মজুর}}, \emph{mojur}.) A salary? (\textbf{\bn{মাইনে}}, \emph{māine}.) A port? (\textbf{\bn{বন্দর}}, \emph{bôndôr}.) A ship? (\textbf{\bn{জাহাজ}}, \emph{jāhāj}.) A train? (\textbf{\bn{ট্রেন}}, \emph{ṭrên}.) A ticket? (\textbf{\bn{টিকিট}}, \emph{ṭikiṭ}.) A mosque? (\textbf{\bn{মসজিদ}}, \emph{mosjid}.) A church? (\textbf{\bn{গির্জা}}, \emph{girjā}.) A pencil? (\textbf{\bn{পেন্সিল}}, \emph{pensil}.) An eraser? (\textbf{\bn{রবার}}, \emph{rôbār}.) A bag? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যাগ}}, \emph{byāg}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
